title: Making Up with a Friend
subtitle: 考点：解决矛盾 / argue with / make up
passage: Lily and Kate have been best friends for five years. Last week, they argued about a school project. Lily wanted to make a poster, but Kate wanted to make a video. Both of them became angry, and they stopped talking to each other.

For three days, they sat far apart in class. Lily felt sad and lonely. She missed talking with Kate at lunch. She asked her older sister for advice. Her sister said, “Calm down first. Then listen to Kate and tell her how you feel. A good friend is more important than a project.”

The next day, Lily wrote a note to Kate. It said, “I'm sorry I was impolite. Can we talk?” Kate read it and smiled. After school, they talked face to face. They decided to make a poster with a short video. In the end, their teacher gave the project an A, and the girls became closer than before.
vocab: argue 争吵 · project 项目 · calm 冷静的 · impolite 不礼貌的 · face to face 面对面 · make up 和好 · advice 建议
